name: Content Raptor
summary: SEO content tool that ranks your pages by traffic potential from Google Search Console data, suggests missing keywords and entities with an AI rewriter, and measures changes with A/B tests and daily rank tracking; priced per site.
best_for: site owners and small agencies with established Search Console traffic who want a prioritised list of pages to improve, an editor to add missing keywords, and A/B tests and rank tracking to check the result
skip_if: your site gets little search traffic yet, you run many sites and need a per-account rather than per-site price, or you track far more than 150 keywords per site
honest_knock: Pricing is per site, so a portfolio pays $47 for every site it connects, and the rank tracker stops at 150 keywords per site. The terms make every purchase non-refundable, and they date from May 2023 with Delaware law and binding arbitration. Recommendations depend on your own Search Console data, so a young site with little traffic gets little out of it. The home page's endorsements, including a founder's quote comparing it with a $1,400-a-year Surfer bill, are customer quotes we could not verify, and the product is the work of one named founder. We have not used Content Raptor ourselves.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Pro · per site per month, billed monthly
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-14 in a live browser on contentraptor.com/pricing, the home page, the about page and the terms and conditions last updated 15 May 2023) Three options. Hobby is free: a 7-day Pro trial, then your top 25 optimisation opportunities with 5 more each week. Pro is $47 a month per site: unlimited A/B tests, unlimited use of the content optimizer and the AI Rewrite tool, unlimited high-opportunity page recommendations, 150 tracked keywords per site updated daily, 100+ search languages and 300+ regions; the home page adds 3-year data retention, historic SerpRobot import and a WordPress integration. Enterprise is a custom package via sales, and the FAQ points sites beyond 20 to a custom plan. The pricing page advertises annual billing as 2 months free; we did not read an annual amount. The home page says the trial needs no credit card. The terms say all purchases are non-refundable; cancellation takes effect at the end of the paid term.

schema_offer.description: Pro, per site per month, billed monthly; annual billing advertised as 2 months free; 150 tracked keywords per site; free Hobby plan with a 7-day Pro trial; purchases non-refundable per the terms. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-10-14.

compare_with.name: Surfer (SurferSEO)
compare_with.why: Surfer is in our dossiers too, re-read on 19 September 2026: Discovery $49 a month billed yearly or $59 monthly, with higher tiers up to $299 and more. Content Raptor, read on 14 October 2026, is $47 a month per site and starts from your own Search Console data instead of the top-ranking pages, with rank tracking and A/B tests included. Surfer is the broader, established content tool priced per account; Content Raptor is narrower and priced per site.
